description: Formalize-first method-class constraint for the α_EM magnitude leg: the two non-vacuous (endpoint) observables of any period-side q-deformation dictionary are identical for the polarized (τ₀·M) and product (τ₀·diag) periods — t→0 exactly (Jacobi + det equality), t→∞ trivially — while the ~12-orders polarization effect (#4043) is confined to the dictionary-gated interior. The q-route collapses onto the τ-functor wall (independent convergence with #4030). Scope-(a); no dictionary fitted; no 8π; nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact (t→0 equality via Jacobi inversion + det identity; t→∞ trivial) + numeric confirmation; scope-(a) method-class constraint

assertions.name: endpoint_t_to_inf_identical
assertions.detail: θ_pol/θ_diag at t=10,20,40: 0.97504618, 0.99968571, 0.9999999506 → 1 monotonically (both θ → 1; deviation decays at the shortest-vector rate e^{−π·0.139·t})

assertions.name: interior_carries_polarization
assertions.detail: θ_pol/θ_diag at t=1: 0.720853 ≠ 1 — the interior differs while both endpoints agree; integrated over the heat kernel this is the ~12-orders determinant separation of #4043 (1.38758 vs 1.4724e12)

result.verdict: ENDPOINT-ANCHORED q-DICTIONARIES ARE POLARIZATION-BLIND (scope-(a), method-class constraint): both dictionary-content endpoints of the period-side q-deformation — the t→0 Jacobi asymptote θ~t⁻⁴/√det (det polarization-independent, so EXACTLY equal) and the trivial t→∞ limit θ→1 — coincide for the principally polarized period τ₀·M and the product period τ₀·diag(5,5,5,1), while the ~12-orders determinant separation (#4043: 1.38758 vs 1.4724e12) lives entirely in the dictionary-gated interior where matching is vacuous (tranche-5 prune). The magnitude leg's period-side q-deformation route therefore carries no dictionary-independent polarization content: the route collapses onto the τ-functor (categorical) wall — independent geometric convergence with #4030's 'irreducibly categorical'. Constrains the METHOD, not any ingredient; the τ-functor route is untouched. No dictionary fitted; no 8π; nothing wired.
